[[Satomi Koorogi]] (Pichu Little) }} The '''Pichu Brothers''' or '''Pichu Bros.''' (Japanese: '''ピチュー兄弟''' ''Pichu Bros.''), individually called '''Pichu Big''' and '''Pichu Little''', are a pair of {{p|Pichu}} who live in [[Big Town]]. ==In animation== They debuted in ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]'', where they met [[Ash's Pikachu]] who was lost after falling off a nearby building, in which {{Ash}} was planning a party celebrating the anniversary of [[EP001|when he and Pikachu first met]]. Pikachu and the Pichu Brothers went throughout [[Big Town]] chased by a {{p|Houndour}} who eventually helped them when the local Pokémon Playhouse was collapsing. In ''[[HS06|Of Meowth and Pokémon (Part One)]]'', the Pichu Posse become embroiled in a picnic basket mix up between {{p|Smoochum}}’s basket and {{MTR}}’s basket. In ''[[HS07|Of Meowth and Pokémon (Part Two)]]'', Meowth enlisted the Posse's assistance to deliver pizzas and later garden maintenance to make money. However things went disastrously wrong with both tasks, with the pizzas all ruined or eaten before delivery, and the parkland flooded after a series of mishaps. To apologize the Pichu Brothers and their friends gave Meowth some acorns. The Pichu Brothers got into a heated argument over who gets to go down a slide first in ''[[Trouble in Big Town]]''. Pichu Little along with {{p|Wooper}} ran off as a result, fleeing to a nearby park where it proceeded to steal a vendor's helium balloons. Consequently, Pichu Little floated up into the air, and had to contend with changing wind currents and {{p|Murkrow}} while Pichu Big and the others searched the city for him. The Posse was later reunited and returned to the Clubhouse to have fun again. In ''[[HS09|Big Meowth, Little Dreams (Part One)]]'', the Pichu Posse joined Meowth in tracking down his missing sandwich and later located the invisible culprit, a {{p|Kecleon}}. It explained that it stole the food to feed a lost {{p|Azurill}}; also the very one that Azumarill was expecting to arrive earlier in the day. With two mysteries solved, the Pichu Brothers and their friends joined Azumarill for a prepared dinner to celebrate Azurill's arrival. Azumarill tasked the Pichu Brothers with looking after Azurill in ''[[HS09|Big Meowth, Little Dreams (Part Two)]]'', but the young Pokémon wandered off under their watch. They later found Azurill in an alleyway, safe and sound. In ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', Meowth was going to throw a [[Meowth's Party|party]]. However, the Pichu Brothers and their friends had not received an invitation and so they went on a quest to find one. In the end, an Azumarill had their invitations all along and hadn't gotten around to delivering them yet. However, they flew away, which led to another adventure to track them down. In ''[[PK11|Camp Pikachu]]'', they had an adventure where they were lost a long way from home after a train ride. However, with the help of Pikachu, some of Ash's and {{an|Misty}}'s Pokémon, as well as a {{p|Wynaut}}, they were able to catch a train back home again. The Pichu Brothers and the Clubhouse appeared during the credits of the Japanese version of ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]''. They made another cameo at the beginning of ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''. The Pichu Brothers most recently appeared in ''[[PK24|Meloetta's Moonlight Serenade]]'' as some of the Pokémon watching {{an|Meloetta}}'s concert. The Pichu Brothers have also appeared in the 2001 version of [[Aim to Be a Pokémon Master|Mezase Pokémon Master]]. They are seen running along a pipe below a bridge that Ash and his friends are standing on. ===Personality and characteristics=== The Pichu Brothers are the recognized leaders of their friendship group, the Pichu Posse. They are often seen playing together at the Pokémon Clubhouse. A call out for help will lead their friends to assemble immediately. Pichu Big, distinguished by a tuft of hair, is the oldest of the pair. He is more mature and sensible while Pichu Little is typically impulsive, playful and argumentative. While they sometimes get into heated arguments, the Pichu Brothers care for one another, as evidenced through the actions in ''[[Trouble in Big Town]]'' where Pichu Big led the search for his lost brother. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|electric||Pichu Bros ThunderShock.png|Using Thunder Shock}} {{anmov|electric|Thunder Shock|PK07|Pikachu & Pichu}} {{anmov/f|electric}} ===Pichu Posse=== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} The '''Pichu Posse''' is a group of Pokémon living in [[Big Town]] that regularly take part in the Pichu Brothers' adventures. A number of them debuted in the Pokémon short, ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]''. {{TrainerPoké |nick=Azumarill |gender=female |type1=Water |img=Azumarill Pichu Bros.png |epnum=Trouble in Big Town |epname=Trouble in Big Town |vajp=Kotono Mitsuishi |vaen=Kayzie Rogers |desc={{p|Azumarill}} first appeared in ''[[Trouble in Big Town]]''. It was making flower chains in a local park when it spotted Pichu Little and {{DL|Pichu Brothers|Wooper}} rolling towards heavy traffic, so it used a {{m|Water Gun}} to propel them across the busy road. It later pointed Pichu Big and the others to Pichu Little's location. Later {{DL|Pichu Brothers|Magby}} called Azumarill in to deal with the Pichu Brothers fighting again. However it was accidentally electrocuted, causing Azumarill to use Water Gun in rage. {{DL|Pichu Brothers|Smoochum}} and Magby used their {{m|Icy Wind}} and {{m|Flamethrower}} attacks to combat the Water attacks, creating a complex of icy slides. The Pokémon put aside their differences to then play on the slides together. Azumarill briefly appeared in ''[[HS06|Of Meowth and Pokémon (Part 1)]]'', where it invited the Pichu Posse to enjoy some acorns. It became cross after the Posse became impatient and knocked all the nuts onto the busy road. In ''[[HS09|Big Meowth, Little Dreams (Part 1)]]'', Azumarill was busy preparing a picnic for its visiting friend {{DL|List of recurring wild Pokémon in the animated series|Azurill}}. {{MTR}} accidentally destroyed Azumarill’s setting while hunting a sandwich thieving {{p|Kecleon}}. Afterwards, Azumarill invited everyone, including Meowth to enjoy Azurill’s welcome party. During ''[[HS10|Big Meowth, Little Dreams (Part 2)]]'', Azumarill was again preparing a picnic lunch for Azurill. It remained behind while the Pichu Posse tried to re-locate Azurill, who wandered off. In ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', {{MTR}} was going to throw a [[Meowth's Party|party]]. However, the Pichu Brothers and their friends had not received an invitation and so they went on a quest to find one. In the end, an {{p|Azumarill}} had their invitations all along and hadn't gotten around to delivering them yet. However, they flew away, which led to another adventure to track them down. Azumarill made a small cameo alongside the other [[Big Town]] Pokémon at the beginning of ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''. Azumarill is kind and generous, often preparing picnics for friends. However, when angered, Azumarill will attack with a barrage of {{m|Water Gun}}s. It spends much of its time amongst the flowers of a [[Big Town]] park. Azumarill's only known move is {{m|Water Gun}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Azurill |type1=Normal |img=Azurill Pichu Bros.png |epnum=HS10 |epname=Big Meowth, Little Dreams (Part 1) |desc={{p|Azurill}} was due to arrive in [[Big Town]] in ''[[HS09|Big Meowth, Little Dreams (Part 1)]]'', to visit its friend {{DL|List of recurring wild Pokémon in the animated series|Azumarill}}. It was later revealed that a friendly {{p|Kecleon}} saw Azurill, and took it to a drain pipe to get it out of the rain. With Azurill found, Azumarill invited everyone to enjoy Azurill's welcome party. During ''[[HS10|Big Meowth, Little Dreams (Part 2)]]'', Azurill wandered off as Azumarill was preparing a picnic lunch. While the Pichu Posse searched Big Town for it, Azurill was interrupting {{MTR}}'s attempts to woo a {{p|Skitty}} by stealing his rose bouquet, cake and ruining his guitar serenade. Meowth's yelling lead the Pichu Brothers and their friends to find Azurill down an alleyway, and rescue it in time. Azurill is a cheery and innocent Pokémon, though it puts itself at risk because of its wild curiosity and tendency to wander off. Azurill's only known move is {{m|Water Gun}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Feraligatr |type1=Water |img=Big Town Feraligatr.png |epnum=Trouble in Big Town |epname=Trouble in Big Town |desc={{p|Feraligatr}} debuted in ''[[Trouble in Big Town]]''. It noticed the Pichu Posse and Houndour being carried off by the river current, so it dived in and rescued them. With a flick of its tail, Pichu Big and friends landed safely while Houndour was put into the path of a Snorlax who squashed it in its sleep. It reappeared briefly in ''[[HS10|Big Meowth, Little Dreams (Part 2)]]'', where it leaped out in time to help a runaway Azurill cross the river safely. Feraligatr resides in a [[Big Town]] river, and it is willing to help anyone in need make a safe river crossing. None of Feraligatr's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Houndour |type1=Dark |type2=Fire |img=Houndour Pichu Bros.png |epnum=PK07 |epname=Pikachu and Pichu |vajp=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Naoki Tatsuta |desc={{p|Houndour}} debuted in ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]'', where it chased after [[Ash's Pikachu]] and the Pichu Brothers after they landed on its back. In its rage it ran directly into the Pokémon Clubhouse, which caused the junk-constructed playground to begin collapsing. Houndour lent its strength to help save the Clubhouse from toppling completely. Houndour reappeared in ''[[HS07|Of Meowth and Pokémon (Part 2)]]'', but it stopped pursuing the Posse after being burned to a crisp by {{p|Magby}}. Houndour's sleep was interrupted in ''[[Trouble in Big Town]]'', when yellow paint was accidentally spilled on it by the Pichu Posse. It chased them down to the river, and its momentum lead everyone to take a dive. A {{DL| List of recurring wild Pokémon in the animated series|Feraligatr}} came to their rescue, but Houndour was tossed directly into Snorlax’s path, where it was squashed under its weight. In ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', the Pichu Brothers jumped on Houndour’s head while chasing after a flyaway invitation. Houndour quickly gave chase, even seeing through the Brother’s makeshift {{p|Piloswine}} disguise. It bided its time as the Pichu fled into a building before the chase resumed. It ended when Houndour was sent blasting off by a broken water hydrant and then flattened by a Snorlax. Houndour made a small cameo alongside the other [[Big Town]] Pokémon at the beginning of ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''. Houndour is a constant source of trouble for the Pichu Brothers and their friends. A running gag involves the Houndour getting hurt in some sort of way, usually being flattened by a local {{DL| List of recurring wild Pokémon in the animated series|Snorlax}}. It is a cunning Pokémon, but very prone to rage. None of Houndour's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Magby |type1=Fire |img=Magby Pichu Bros.png |epnum=PK07 |epname=Pikachu and Pichu |vajp=Yūji Ueda |desc={{p|Magby}} first appeared in ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]''. After the Clubhouse was ruined by a rampaging Houndour, Magby lent its strength and later used Flamethrower to weld the pipe slide back together. In ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', Magby helped the Pichu brothers look for invitations to Meowth's party. Magby is a brave and yet short-tempered Pokémon, preferring to attack over rationalizing. Magby's only known move is {{m|Flamethrower}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Meowth (Team Rocket) |gender=male |type1=Normal |img=HS07.png |epnum=EP002 |epname=Pokémon Emergency! |vajp=Inuko Inuyama |vaen=Maddie Blaustein |main=Meowth (Team Rocket) |desc=In ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', {{p|Meowth}} threw a big party for the Pokémon of the city where he was serving lots of fruit. The party was invitation-only and Meowth assigned the task of delivering invitations to Azumarill.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Murkrow (multiple) |type1=Dark |type2=Flying |img=Big Town Murkrow.png |epnum=PK07 |epname=Pikachu & Pichu |desc={{p|Murkrow}} first appeared in ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]'', along with some of its friends. Later a single Murkrow noticed {{AP|Pikachu}} attempting to cling onto a rope as he hung between two buildings. Instead of assisting, Murkrow loosened the rope tie at one end, though a few passing {{p|Hoppip}} helped Pikachu to safety. In ''[[Trouble in Big Town]]'', Pichu Little was sent flying off into the distance after stealing some balloons from a park vendor. The mischievous Murkrow made things only more difficult, when it began popping all the balloons. Luckily Wooper used {{m|Water Gun}} in time, making for a softer landing. Murkrow and its friends made a small cameo alongside the other [[Big Town]] Pokémon at the beginning of ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''. The Murkrow are troublemakers and feared across [[Big Town]]. They have a menacing stare and get a thrill out of putting others into harm's way. None of Murkrow's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Smeargle |type1=Normal |img=Big Town Smeargle.png |epnum=PK07 |epname=Pikachu and Pichu |vajp=Kōichi Sakaguchi |desc={{p|Smeargle}} was among the many Pokémon that were shown playing at the [[Big Town|Pokémon Clubhouse]] in ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]''. It later lent a hand after the Clubhouse began to collapse because of {{p|Houndour}}'s actions. In ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', Smeargle was playing with its friend {{p|Aipom}} at the park amphitheatre when the Pichu Posse arrived demanding to know about the strange crescent-shaped cards everyone has. Using Smeargle's tail, Aipom painted a picture of fruit and a clock tower, directing the Posse over to the location of {{MTR}}'s upcoming party. It reappeared in ''[[HS09|Big Meowth, Little Dreams (Part 1)]]'', while Meowth and the Pichu Posse where looking for a sandwich thief. Pichu Big has Smeargle splash the paint on its tail everywhere, which revealed the invisible culprit to be a {{p|Kecleon}}. Smeargle made a small cameo alongside the other [[Big Town]] Pokémon at the beginning of ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''. Smeargle is cheery and playful, often spending its days painting walls across [[Big Town]] with bright colors. None of Smeargle's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Smoochum |gender=female |type1=Ice |type2=Psychic |img=Smoochum Pichu Bros.png |epnum=PK07 |epname=Pikachu and Pichu |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen=Tara Jayne |desc=In ''[[HS06|Of Meowth and Pokémon (Part One)]]'', {{p|Smoochum}}'s basket of cosmetics was accidentally mixed up by {{MTR}}, who bumped into her, and grabbed what he thought was his picnic basket full of food. She alerted the Pichu Posse to the situation, and her basket was later returned after Meowth left it on the ground while trying to catch his own basket. In ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', Smoochum was the first to learn of {{MTR}}'s party after seeing everyone holding the crescent-shaped invitations. She alerted the Pichu Posse, who were yet to receive their invites, and helped the Pichu brothers look for invitations to Meowth's party. Smoochum is very worried about her appearance, often shown applying makeup and looking at herself in a mirror. Smoochum's only known move is {{m|Icy Wind}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Snorlax |type1=Normal |img=Snorlax Pichu Bros.png |epnum=PK07 |epname=Pikachu and Pichu |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |desc={{p|Snorlax}} is a recurring character throughout the Pichu Brothers shorts. First appearing in ''[[PK07|Pikachu & Pichu]]'', it rolled over in its sleep and crushed {{p|Houndour}} as it was chasing after the Pichu Brothers and {{AP|Pikachu}}. In ''[[HS07|Of Meowth and Pokémon (Part 2)]]'', Snorlax rolled onto Teddiursa as it was about to tuck into some pizza it was supposed to deliver. It appeared in ''[[Trouble in Big Town]]'' and again in ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', where it accidentally squashed Houndour who was again pursuing the Pichu Brothers and their friends. Snorlax made a small cameo alongside the other [[Big Town]] Pokémon at the beginning of ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''. Snorlax is a restless sleeper, with unfortunate Pokémon like Houndour, being squashed under its weight. None of Snorlax's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Squirtle Squad |type1=Water |img=Squirtle Squad.png |epnum=EP012 |epname=Here Comes the Squirtle Squad |vajp=Ikue Ohtani |vaen=Eric Stuart |main=Squirtle Squad |desc=Three members of the {{p|Squirtle}} Squad were first seen using {{m|Water Gun}} against Smoochum in [[Of Meowth and Pokémon (Part 2)]]. They were also seen in ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', where they helped out in setting up the party, and guarding the food from thieves.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Teddiursa |type1=Normal |img=Teddiursa Pichu Bros.png |epnum=Trouble in Big Town |epname=Trouble in Big Town |vajp=Yuri Shiratori |vaen=Tara Jayne |desc={{p|Teddiursa}}’s appetite led to the events that unfolded in ''[[HS06|Of Meowth and Pokémon (Part One)]]''. It ate the food from Meowth’s picnic basket, much to Meowth’s disappointment. In ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', Teddiursa helped the Pichu brothers look for invitations to Meowth's party. Teddiursa is a gluttonous Pokémon, as seen when it slyly tried to eat the pizza it was supposed to deliver as well as food in the picnic basket it was supposed to deliver to Meowth. It often gets side-tracked by the smell of food. Teddiursa also sleeps in the park where it guards its precious acorns from other hungry Pokémon. None of Teddiursa's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |nick=Wooper |type1=Water |type2=Ground |img=Wooper Pichu Bros.png |epnum=PK07 |epname=Pikachu and Pichu |vajp=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Mayumi Shintani |vaen=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Mayumi Shintani |desc=In ''[[Trouble in Big Town]]'', {{p|Wooper}} ran off with Pichu Little to a park after the Pichu Brothers had an argument. After Pichu Little stole some helium balloons and was sent flying, Wooper joined the others of the Posse to search for him. Later, Wooper's Water Gun helped Pichu Little make a softer landing. In ''[[Pichu Bros. in Party Panic]]'', Wooper helped the Pichu brothers look for invitations to Meowth's party. Wooper is a very happy-go-lucky Wooper that is almost always seen smiling. However its clumsy on land and often oblivious to the situation, so the others of the Posse direct its Water Gun attack to help for a softer landing. Wooper's only known move is {{m|Water Gun}}.}} ==In the manga== [[File:Pichu Brothers PM.png|thumb|200px|The Pichu Brothers in Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] ===Pokémon: Yeah!
